summary: Chelan County, WA summit with a reported 1934 crow's nest that a hiking guide disputes; no lookout stands and communication equipment is on the summit.

facts.status_note: No lookout stands; communication equipment is on the summit.

access.note: A hiking guide describes a trail from a parking area. No land-manager page was read to confirm the access.

visit.trail_note: Two trails leave the parking area. The steeper one climbs about 1,000 feet in half a mile to the ridge; the parking lot is usually cleared all winter.

events.note: Reported as a crow's nest (firelookout.com), which also says it was abandoned in the 1930s; a hiking guide says a 1935 photograph shows none, so the build is disputed

evidence.supports: about three miles southwest of Entiat

notes_for_editor: Thin evidence and a source conflict. firelookout.com dates a crow's nest to 1934; the hiking guide says a 1935 photograph shows none and that there was probably only a camp and firefinder. The story gives both. A geocache listing (GCNRT7) says the summit holds a TV reflector and radio receiving station, but the fetch returned only its title, so that claim is not used. The Weebly page for the site gives only the county and a land description (25N-20E-25). The record's kind 'platform' fits the FFLA type 'Crowsnest', so no correction is proposed. The record's status 'gone' fits a site with no lookout; the FFLA word is 'Abandoned'. The Wenatchee National Forest agency comes from firelookout.com only and was not checked against a Forest Service page.
